integrity: Analytic proof reconstructs the phase portrait, weighted contraction, nonzero-equilibrium stability and center-manifold cubic coefficient. Standalone numeric tests supplement but cannot establish the infinite-family statements. Static bipartite symmetry breaking is prior knowledge; potential priority overlap in specialized deterministic literature remains possible. The later bipartite Glauber mean-field stationary bifurcation literature is cited as partial prior coverage of static components, not of the critical Q-learning trajectory coefficient.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete bipartite graphs with equal positive exploration, identical symmetric two-action mismatch payoffs, and deterministic continuous-time Q-learning ODE. Excludes discrete-time stochastic learning and asynchronous logit chains; the central limit expansion is local and does not yield a uniform error bound over all initial conditions.
title: Sharp exploration threshold and critical relaxation in bipartite anti-coordination learning
